# NKY Cabinet Refacing Pros

## About
NKY Cabinet Refacing Pros provides cabinet painting, cabinet refinishing, and cabinet refacing for kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and built-in cabinetry in Cincinnati & Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties). Free estimates by phone: (714) 494-9486.

## Services
- Cabinet painting: kitchen cabinets, vanities, and built-ins painted in the color you choose
- Cabinet refinishing: worn, faded, or dated finishes restored or changed with new stain, clear coat, or paint
- Cabinet refacing: new doors, drawer fronts, and hardware on existing cabinet boxes, most kitchens done in 3-5 days; soft-close and pull-out upgrades available

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
